connector.name: Altmetric MCP by mcp.altmetric.com
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Altmetric APIs - track research attention across news, policy, social media, and more
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.altmetric.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package altmetric-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.altmetric.mcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ALTMETRIC_DETAILS_API_KEY
env.description: API key for Altmetric Details Page API. At least one credential set required: either this key OR both Explorer API credentials

env.name: ALTMETRIC_EXPLORER_API_KEY
env.description: API key for Altmetric Explorer API (requires ALTMETRIC_EXPLORER_API_SECRET). At least one credential set required

env.name: ALTMETRIC_EXPLORER_API_SECRET
env.description: API secret for Altmetric Explorer API HMAC authentication (requires ALTMETRIC_EXPLORER_API_KEY)
